headline: Musk says Tesla and SpaceX discussing a possible merger
summary: Elon Musk said Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees of independent directors, requested by shareholders, to explore a possible merger. He called the idea appealing but said he isn't on either committee and that nothing is certain; the Guardian reports any deal would need approval from half of Tesla's shareholders.
